sentences.text: Mogadishu -LRB- -LSB- ˌmɔːɡəˈdiːʃuː -RSB- Muqdisho -LSB- mʉqdɪʃɔ -RSB- ; مقديشو -LSB- maqadiːʃuː -RSB- -RRB- , known locally as Hamar , is the capital and most populous city of Somalia .	capital	capital city	most populous city	List of cities in Somalia by population	Somalia	Somalia
Located in the coastal Banaadir region on the Indian Ocean , the city has served as an important port for millennia .	Banaadir	Banaadir	Indian Ocean	Indian Ocean
, it has a population of 2,425,000 residents .
Tradition and old records assert that southern Somalia , including the Mogadishu area , was historically inhabited by hunter-gatherers .	Somalia	Somalia
These were later joined by Cushitic-speaking agro-pastoralists , who would go on to establish local aristocracies .	Cushitic	Cushitic languages

During its medieval Golden Age , Mogadishu was ruled by the Muzaffar dynasty , a vassal of the Ajuran Sultanate .	Golden Age	Golden Age	Muzaffar dynasty	Sultanate of Mogadishu	Ajuran Sultanate	Ajuran Sultanate
It subsequently fell under the control of an assortment of local Sultanates and polities , most notably the Sultanate of the Geledi .	Sultanate of the Geledi	Sultanate of the Geledi
The city later became the capital of Italian Somaliland -LRB- 1889 -- 1936 -RRB- in the colonial period .	capital	capital city	Italian Somaliland	Italian Somaliland
After the Somali Republic became independent in 1960 , Mogadishu became known and promoted as the White Pearl of the Indian Ocean .	Somali	Somali language	Indian Ocean	Indian Ocean

After the ousting of the Siad Barre regime in 1991 and the ensuing Somali Civil War , various militias fought for control of the city , later to be replaced by the Islamic Courts Union in the mid-2000s .	Somali	Somali language	Siad Barre	Siad Barre	Somali Civil War	Somali Civil War	Islamic Courts Union	Islamic Courts Union

The ICU thereafter splintered into more radical groups , notably al-Shabaab , which fought the Transitional Federal Government -LRB- 2004 -- 2012 -RRB- and its African Union Mission to Somalia allies .	Somalia	Somalia	al-Shabaab	al-Shabaab (militant group)	Transitional Federal Government	Transitional Federal Government	African Union Mission to Somalia	African Union Mission to Somalia
With a change in administration in late 2010 , government troops and their military partners had succeeded in forcing out Al-Shabaab by August 2011 .
Mogadishu has subsequently experienced a period of intense reconstruction .
As Somalia 's capital city , many important national institutions are based in Mogadishu .	capital	capital city	Somalia	Somalia

It is the seat of the Federal Government of Somalia established in August 2012 , with the Somalia Federal Parliament serving as the government 's legislative branch .	Somalia	Somalia	Federal Government of Somalia	Federal Government of Somalia	Somalia Federal Parliament	Federal Parliament of Somalia	legislative	Legislature
Thabit Abdi Mohammed has been the Mayor of Mogadishu since April 2017 .	Mayor	Mayor	 Thabit Abdi Mohammed 	 Thabit Abdi Mohammed

Villa Somalia is the official residential palace and principal workplace of the President of Somalia , Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed .	Somalia	Somalia	Villa Somalia	Villa Somalia	official residential	official residence	palace	presidential palace	President of Somalia	President of Somalia	Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed	Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed

In May 2012 , the First Somali Bank was established in the capital , which organized Mogadishu 's first ever Technology , Entertainment , Design -LRB- TEDx -RRB- conference .	Somali	Somali language	capital	capital city	First Somali Bank	First Somali Bank
The establishment of a local construction yard has also galvanized the city 's real-estate sector .
Arba'a Rukun Mosque is one of the oldest Islamic places of worship in the capital , built circa 667 -LRB- 1268/9 AD -RRB- .	capital	capital city	Arba'a Rukun Mosque	Arba'a Rukun Mosque
The Mosque of Islamic Solidarity in Mogadishu is the largest masjid in the Horn region .	Mosque of Islamic Solidarity	Mosque of Islamic Solidarity	Horn	Horn of Africa

Mogadishu Cathedral was built in 1928 by the colonial authorities in Italian Somaliland in a Norman Gothic style , and served as the traditional seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mogadiscio .	Italian Somaliland	Italian Somaliland	Mogadishu Cathedral	Mogadishu Cathedral	Norman	Norman architecture	Gothic	Gothic Revival architecture	Roman Catholic Diocese of Mogadiscio	Roman Catholic Diocese of Mogadiscio
The National Museum of Somalia is based in Mogadishu and holds many culturally important artefacts .	Somalia	Somalia	National Museum of Somalia	National Museum of Somalia

The National Library of Somalia is undergoing a $ 1 million Somali federal government funded renovation , including a new library complex .	Somali	Somali language	Somalia	Somalia	National Library of Somalia	National Library of Somalia
Mogadishu is home to a number of scholastic and media institutions .
As part of the municipality 's urban renewal program , 100 schools across the capital are scheduled to be refurbished and reopened .	capital	capital city

The Somali National University -LRB- SNU -RRB- was established in the 1950s , and professors from the university later founded the non-governmental Mogadishu University -LRB- MU -RRB- .	Somali	Somali language	Somali National University	Somali National University	Mogadishu University	Mogadishu University
Benadir University -LRB- BU -RRB- was established in 2002 with the intention of training doctors .	Benadir University	Benadir University

Various national sporting bodies have their headquarters in Mogadishu , including the Somali Football Federation and the Somali Olympic Committee .	Somali	Somali language	Somali Football Federation	Somali Football Federation	Somali Olympic Committee	Somali Olympic Committee
Mogadishu Stadium was constructed in 1978 during the Siad Barre administration , with the assistance of Chinese engineers .	Siad Barre	Siad Barre	Mogadishu Stadium	Mogadishu Stadium

It hosts football matches with teams from the Somali First Division and the Somalia Cup .	Somali	Somali language	Somalia	Somalia	football	association football	Somali First Division	Somali First Division	Somalia Cup	Somalia Cup
Additionally , the Port of Mogadishu serves as a major national seaport and is the largest harbour in Somalia .	Somalia	Somalia	Port of Mogadishu	Port of Mogadishu
